items.informal_name: Weighted Order Upper Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the coefficient of a monomial $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero, then the weighted order of $ f $ is less than or equal to the weight of $ d $, i.e., $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) \leq \sum_{i \in \operatorname{support} d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $.

items.informal_name: Lower bound on total weight from a non-zero component
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {w : σ → M},
  (∀ (s : σ), 0 ≤ w s) → ∀ {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, f s ≠ 0 → w s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f
items.informal_description: Let `σ` be an index set and `M` be an ordered additive commutative monoid. Let `w: σ → M` be a weight function with non-negative values, i.e., `w(s) ≥ 0` for all `s ∈ σ`. For any function `f : σ →₀ ℕ` with finite support, its total weight is defined as `weight w f = ∑_{s' ∈ σ} f(s') w(s')`. The theorem states that if `f(s) ≠ 0` for some index `s ∈ σ`, then `w(s)` provides a lower bound for the total weight, i.e., `w(s) ≤ weight w f`.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound on Weighted Order of Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For any extended natural number $n$, if every monomial $d$ with $\text{weight}(w, d) < n$ has zero coefficient in the multivariate power series $f$, then $n \leq \text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$, where $\text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$ denotes the weighted order of $f$ with respect to the weight function $w$.

items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if every monomial $ d $ with weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) < n $ has zero coefficient in $ f $, then the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to $ w $ satisfies $ n \leq \text{weightedOrder}_w(f) $.

items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of $ f $ is the minimal natural number $ n $ such that there exists a monomial $ d $ with non-zero coefficient in $ f $ where the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ equals $ n $.       "informal_name": "Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra",
      "kind": "abbrev",
      "type": "{R : Type u_1} →\n  {A : Type u_3} →\n    {T : Type u_4} →\n      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T",
      "informal_description": "For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_pow",
      "informal_name": "Lower bound on degree of support under exponentiation in additive monoid algebra",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]\n  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},\n  0 ≤ degt 0 →\n    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →\n      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), n • f.support.inf degt ≤ (f ^ n).support.inf degt",
      "informal_description": "Let $ R $ be a semiring and $ A $ an additive monoid. For any function $ \\deg : A \\to \\mathbb{R} $ satisfying $ \\deg(0) \\geq 0 $ and $ \\deg(a + b) \\geq \\deg(a) + \\deg(b) $ for all $ a, b \\in A $, and for any $ f \\in R[A] $ and $ n \\in \\mathbb{N} $, the inequality $ n \\cdot \\inf_{a \\in \\text{supp}(f)} \\deg(a) \\leq \\inf_{a \\in \\text{supp}(f^n)} \\deg(a) $ holds, where $ \\text{supp}(f) $ denotes the support of $ f $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "AddMonoidAlgebra.le_infDegree_add",
      "informal_name": "Infimum Degree Subadditivity in Additive Monoid Algebra",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T]\n  (D : A → T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A),\n  AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D f ⊓ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D g ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D (f + g)",
      "informal_description": "For any two elements $f$ and $g$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$, the infimum of their individual infimum degrees with respect to a degree ordering $D$ satisfies $\\inf(\\deg(f), \\deg(g)) \\leq \\deg(f + g)$, where $\\deg(-)$ denotes the infimum degree function.",

    },

      "informal_name": "Meet of Infima of Supports is Less Than or Equal to Infimum of Support of Sum",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]\n  (degt : A → T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), f.support.inf degt ⊓ g.support.inf degt ≤ (f + g).support.inf degt",
      "informal_description": "For elements $ f $ and $ g $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[M] $, the infimum of their supports with respect to the degree function satisfies $ \\inf(\\text{supp}(f)) \\sqcap \\inf(\\text{supp}(g)) \\leq \\inf(\\text{supp}(f + g)) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_finset_prod",
      "informal_name": "Infimum Degree Inequality in Additive Monoid Algebra Product",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T]\n  [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T]\n  {degt : A → T},\n  0 ≤ degt 0 →\n    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →\n      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A), ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).support.inf degt",
      "informal_description": "For a commutative semiring $ R $ and an additive commutative monoid $ A $, let $ \\text{degt} : A \\to \\mathbb{R} $ satisfy $ \\text{degt}(0) \\geq 0 $ and $ \\text{degt}(a + b) \\geq \\text{degt}(a) + \\text{degt}(b) $. For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : s \\to R[A] $, the sum of the infima of $ \\text{degt} $ over the supports of each $ f(i) $ is less than or equal to the infimum of $ \\text{degt} $ over the support of the product $ \\prod_{i \\in s} f(i) $.",

  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), n • f.support.inf degt ≤ (f ^ n).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring and $ A $ an additive monoid. For any function $ \deg : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfying $ \deg(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \deg(a + b) \geq \deg(a) + \deg(b) $ for all $ a, b \in A $, and for any $ f \in R[A] $ and $ n \in \mathbb{N} $, the inequality $ n \cdot \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f)} \deg(a) \leq \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f^n)} \deg(a) $ holds, where $ \text{supp}(f) $ denotes the support of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Infimum Degree Subadditivity in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T]
  (D : A → T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D f ⊓ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D g ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D (f + g)
items.informal_description: For any two elements $f$ and $g$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$, the infimum of their individual infimum degrees with respect to a degree ordering $D$ satisfies $\inf(\deg(f), \deg(g)) \leq \deg(f + g)$, where $\deg(-)$ denotes the infimum degree function.

items.informal_name: Meet of Infima of Supports is Less Than or Equal to Infimum of Support of Sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  (degt : A → T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), f.support.inf degt ⊓ g.support.inf degt ≤ (f + g).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For elements $ f $ and $ g $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[M] $, the infimum of their supports with respect to the degree function satisfies $ \inf(\text{supp}(f)) \sqcap \inf(\text{supp}(g)) \leq \inf(\text{supp}(f + g)) $.

items.informal_name: Infimum Degree Inequality in Additive Monoid Algebra Product
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T]
  {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A), ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For a commutative semiring $ R $ and an additive commutative monoid $ A $, let $ \text{degt} : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfy $ \text{degt}(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \text{degt}(a + b) \geq \text{degt}(a) + \text{degt}(b) $. For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : s \to R[A] $, the sum of the infima of $ \text{degt} $ over the supports of each $ f(i) $ is less than or equal to the infimum of $ \text{degt} $ over the support of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f(i) $.
